status_history.owner_words: Owner placed the file in docs/marketing/approved-creative-examples/notable-lot/ as a good example of creative work.

source.origin: Seller-published social creative, Owner-selected (same campaign as REF-01; seller identified only by the URL)
source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.
source.event_date_visible: Tuesday, April 29 · starting at noon CT · Online only

classification.event_product_type: Single hero object (backlit quartz crystal on matrix) for a specialty online auction

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: One dramatic object fills the right two-thirds and the bottom; the title stack (ROCK SPECIMEN white serif, DESIGNER PURSE / AUCTION orange) sits top-left over the dark ground; date/time/online-only; 'Featuring' line; CTA box bottom-left. Thin orange frame.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: A single clear quartz crystal on its matrix, backlit so the edges glow, with lens flare highlights; the matrix runs off the bottom edge.
visual_read.composition_style: Hero object on a near-black ground; text column left; the light IS the composition.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Same serif/sans system as REF-01, reversed to white with orange emphasis.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: No seller logo — only the URL in the CTA box identifies the seller.
visual_read.cta_treatment: Boxed 'BID ONLINE! LMAuctionCo.com' with orange outline on dark.
visual_read.footer_treatment: None; the CTA box and orange frame close the canvas.
visual_read.photographic_style: Dramatic backlit macro photography, dark field, specular highlights.

strongest_attributes: The only dark-ground ad the Owner approved — and it is a single lit object where darkness makes the light visible
Generous negative space used deliberately (dark field around the crystal)
Same campaign as REF-01: the Owner approved a hero-object variant alongside the still-life variant
transferable_lessons: Dark ground is justified by a specific trigger — one hero object whose lighting, translucency or reflectivity is the story (validates the 3M.1 decision: dark is a specialised treatment, not an equal default)
Notable-lot creative = one object, dramatic scale, the same short copy set
A campaign may pair a hero-object creative with a broader still-life or scene creative
do_not_generalize: Orange accent, ornament glyphs, decorative frame — seller identity
Absence of the seller logo — an Advantage.Bid creative always carries the presenter and the navy footer
Dark ground for anything other than a lit hero object

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Reversed type on a dark field reads cleanly because the object leaves the left third empty.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Object on matrix; the matrix is the ground.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Crystal rises from its matrix at the bottom edge — grounded by the crop.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Object ≈ 60% of canvas height; the biggest thing in the frame by far.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Matrix exits the bottom and right edges; the crystal itself is whole.

use_cases: minerals, glass, crystal, lit or reflective objects

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
